Container.Name: ClawChives
Container.Overview: 🦞 ClawChives is a privacy-first, self-hostable pinchmark (bookmark) manager designed for the Human-Agent ecosystem. Reclaim your links from the cloud, secure them with ShellCryption©™, and collaborate with sovereign AI Lobsters to scuttle the web. Features include agent-specific LobsterKeys©™, reading mode via r.jina.ai, and high-fidelity branded exports.

Config.Name: Web GUI
Config.Description: The Default Port for the Web GUI

Config.Name: DB Encryption Key
Config.Description: Key to encrypt the database (Optional). Defaults to no encryption if none provided.

Config.Name: SuperAdmin Access Token
Config.Description: Security token for accessing the isolated /admin SuperAdmin panel. Requires high entropy (e.g., random 64+ character string). Leave empty to completely disable all /admin control plane UI and API routes.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Linux Group ID for file permissions

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Linux User ID for file permissions

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 'true' if running behind a reverse proxy (Nginx, Traefik, etc.)
